create_dataset_config: create a DatasetConfig dataclass to specify path, split, columns, and data_files for a HuggingFace dataset
create_dataset_mixture_config: create a DatasetMixtureConfig dataclass to combine multiple DatasetConfig entries with streaming and test split options
parse_cli_args_config: parse command-line arguments and YAML config file into dataclass instances using TrlParser with environment variable support
load_dataset_mixture: load and concatenate multiple datasets from DatasetMixtureConfig with optional column selection and train/test splitting
get_git_commit_hash: get the git commit hash for a given Python package by locating its repository root and running git rev-parse
